evidence.quote: A positioning note used by the navigation/provenance regression guard.

observations.why: Flat descriptive assertion of what the note is for — no hedging, no permanence language, no ratification; a confident but moveable claim.

evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Stated as bedrock distinction — categorical, unhedged, creed-like; the sentence form itself ('is not the same as') treats the distinction as constitutive, not argued for.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Permanence language ('the asset you keep') frames perspective as a constitutive value, not a finding to be debated; repetition of the owned-intelligence creed at principle level.
Self-aware restatement of a thesis — assertive and committed, but explicitly framed as a restatement for a downstream purpose, not performed as settled bedrock; claim-level.

mints.title: owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence
mints.frame: Is the conviction here performed as a constitutive distinction the speaker treats as bedrock, rather than as a finding to be argued?
